text:
Nina R: quick thread 99999Heads-up: i'm about to push the internal release note for 2.15.0. need final checks on pin wording + rollback rules. aim to post internal blast at 16:45 PT.
Carlos M: dropping the draft now. i'm also going to add the model artifact SHAs and the exact pin command.
DevOps Bot: staging smoke ok. preflight snapshot created: snap-2026-03-23-1601.
Sam T: suggested canary plan: 3% for 20m, then 20% for 20m, then full. can we include an emergency 0% kill switch in the note for oncall?
Nina R: yes include the kill-switch command and mention who is authorized to trigger it.
oncall-rotations: @Sam T stands up 16:30-19:30 for this deploy.
Carlos M: inserted the following lines into the PR: 
```
Model pins: model-x@sha256:aa11bb22, model-x-quant@sha256:cc33dd44.
Pin command: rbinctl pin --env=prod --model=model-x --hash=aa11bb22
Kill switch: rbinctl traffic --env=prod --set-canary=0 (oncall only)
```
Sam T: rollback criteria proposal: any of the following -> (a) 5m error rate >= 2.5%, (b) P95 token latency increase >= 50% relative baseline, (c) regression test failures in smoke suite >= 2 tests. If any single threshold met, reduce canary to 0% and notify channel #eng-oncall; if two or more met, escalate to SEV process.
Nina R: that's pretty clear. shorten language for internal announce, but keep full criteria in linked runbook. also call out Dedicated customers will be pinned automatically; private customers will get an advisory email.
DevOps Bot: scheduled deploy window: 16:45-17:45 PT. posting announce to #eng as configured at 16:50 PT. quiet-mode set to #eng-oncall.
Carlos M: added small note about metrics to watch: token_latency.p95, inference.errors.per_minute, model_memory. also included Grafana dashboard link: https://grafana/reports/deploy-2-15-0
Sam T: add a line telling people how long to wait before escalating to a manual rollback in the runbook: "wait 5 minutes after reducing traffic to 0 to validate stabilizing metrics before full rollback"
Nina R: agree. final timeline: 15:30 final copy due to ops, 16:00 model hashes locked, 16:30 oncall confirmed, 16:45 deploy window.
Carlos M: final copy pushed to PR and pasted below.
```
Internal announce (short): Releasing 2.15.0 at 16:45 PT. Highlights: reduced tail latency via batching kernel updates, optional model pin UI, and console bugfixes. Canary: 3% for 20m -> 20% for 20m -> full. Rollback: reduce canary to 0% on: 5m error rate >=2.5% OR P95 latency +50% OR >=2 failed smoke tests; if two thresholds met, follow SEV escalation. Owners: Nina R (PM), Carlos M (Release Eng), Sam T (Oncall). Pin commands, model hashes, and full rollback playbook: see PR #4899 and runbook link.
```
oncall-rotations: i'm on standby. will monitor dashboards and have kill-switch ready.
DevOps Bot: deploy announcement queued for 16:50 PT.
Nina R: thanks — i'll post the internal blast at 16:50 with the one-liner: "Deploying 2.15.0 to hosted/dedicated. Canary 3% -> 20% -> full. Rollback rules in internal note." kept short.
Carlos M: pasted exact model SHAs into the internal note as requested.
Sam T: confirmed monitoring playbook added to PR.
Nina R: final checklist for this thread: 1) ops receives final copy by 15:30 (done), 2) hashes locked by 16:00 (done), 3) oncall standby confirmed (done), 4) deploybot scheduled (done). posting the internal announce at 16:50. good job team :rocket:
